14
Four changes are described.
1
When sodium is added to water, thermal energy is released.
2
When water boils, thermal energy is absorbed.
3
When concentrated sulfuric acid is added to water, the temperature of the
surroundings increases.
4
When ammonium nitrate is added to water, the temperature of the
surroundings decreases.
Which changes are endothermic?
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
2 and 4
subject: Chemistry

content.html: When sodium is added to water, thermal energy is released. When water boils, thermal energy is absorbed. When concentrated sulfuric acid is added to water, the temperature of the surroundings increases. When ammonium nitrate is added to water, the temperature of the surroundings decreases.
